programmes.d: A man whose life was saved by an outlaw shows his gratitude by reluctantly assisting in a stagecoach robbery.
An ex-convict (Phil Carey) and his girlfriend (Martha Hyer) cannot start over until they stop Butch Cassidy's (Gene Evans) gang.
A fugitive lawman (Audie Murphy) leaves Mexico to get the Texas saloon boss (Broderick Crawford) who framed him and killed his brother.
Two guys (Rod Cameron, Wayne Morris) find stages hijacked for sale to Rebels.

programmes.t: The Gun That Won the West
programmes.d: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.
A mustang stallion runs swiftly to the rescue when the boy who befriended him is endangered.
Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.
Flaming arrows stop four ex-convicts searching a ghost town for their buried loot.
A Texas Ranger (Guy Madison) turns deputy sheriff; a woman (Valerie French) wants him to kill her cattle-baron husband (Lorne Greene).
Lawyer Al (Dan Duryea) and brother Frank (Dick Foran) turn to robbing banks and trains after Union troops raid their home.
An Old West gunfighter (Hal Holbrook) turns a young farmer (Jeff Osterhage) into a justice fighter with a special gun.

programmes.t: The New Daughters of Joshua Cabe
programmes.d: A framed sheriff (John McIntire) is about to hang, but his bogus wayward daughters have a plan.
A British scout (Kevin Dillon) infiltrates a French stronghold near the Great Lakes during the 1750s.
A bank robber (Fred MacMurray) takes a new name in another town and falls for the lawyer-sheriff's (Lin McCarthy) sister (Dorothy Green).
Cowboy Santa Fe Stewart (Buck Jones) fights a tyrant in Spanish California.
A preacher (Van Heflin) with a reckless past rebuilds a church after the Civil War with a teenage girl (Joanne Woodward) from the hills.
